# Block 3: Data Reading
def read_staging_data():
    """Read all JSON invoice files and extract ALL invoices"""
    try:
        print(f"📂 Reading from: {STAGING_DIRECTORY}")
        
        files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(STAGING_DIRECTORY)
        json_files = [f.path for f in files if f.name.lower().endswith('.json')]
        
        print(f"🔍 Found {len(json_files)} JSON files")
        
        all_dataframes = []
        total_invoices = 0
        
        for file_path in json_files:
            text_df = spark.read.text(file_path)
            rows = text_df.collect()
            
            if rows:
                import json
                invoices_list = []
                
                for row in rows:
                    line = row[0].strip() if row[0] else ""
                    if line:
                        try:
                            # Handle both array format and single object format
                            if line.startswith('['):
                                # Array of invoices
                                invoice_array = json.loads(line)
                                invoices_list.extend(invoice_array)
                            else:
                                # Single invoice object
                                invoice_data = json.loads(line)
                                invoices_list.append(invoice_data)
                        except Exception as e:
                            print(f"⚠️ Error parsing line in {file_path}: {e}")
                            continue
                
                if invoices_list:
                    invoice_records = []
                    for i, invoice in enumerate(invoices_list):
                        invoice_records.append({
                            "json_data_string": json.dumps(invoice),
                            "source_file_name": file_path,
                            "invoice_index": i
                        })
                    
                    invoices_df = spark.createDataFrame(invoice_records)
                    all_dataframes.append(invoices_df)
                    total_invoices += len(invoices_list)
                    print(f"✅ {os.path.basename(file_path)}: {len(invoices_list)} invoices")
        
        if not all_dataframes:
            print("❌ No invoice data found!")
            return None
            
        print(f"📊 TOTAL INVOICES FOUND: {total_invoices}")
        
        # Union all DataFrames
        final_df = all_dataframes[0]
        for df in all_dataframes[1:]:
            final_df = final_df.union(df)
        
        # Parse back to structured format
        structured_df = final_df.select(
            from_json(col("json_data_string"), complete_invoice_schema).alias("parsed_invoice"),
            col("source_file_name").alias("source_file"),
            col("invoice_index")
        ).select("parsed_invoice.*", "source_file", "invoice_index")
        
        return structured_df.cache()
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error reading data: {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        raise

print("✓ Block 3 completed: Data reading")

# Block 4: Invoice Line Items Extraction
def extract_invoice_lines(df):
    """Extract invoice line items - FLATTENED FOR DATA FLOW"""
    print("🔍 Extracting invoice line items...")
    
    invoices_with_lines = df.filter(col("lines").isNotNull() & (size(col("lines")) > 0))
    
    if invoices_with_lines.count() == 0:
        print("ℹ️ No invoice lines found")
        return None
    
    invoice_lines = invoices_with_lines.select(
        col("id").alias("invoice_id"),
        col("invoice_nr"),
        col("draft_nr"),
        col("company_id"),
        col("client_id"),
        col("client_name"),
        col("status").alias("invoice_status"),
        col("description").alias("invoice_description"),
        col("total_excl_vat").alias("invoice_total_excl_vat"),
        col("total_vat").alias("invoice_total_vat"),
        col("total_incl_vat").alias("invoice_total_incl_vat"),
        col("total_discount").alias("invoice_total_discount"),
        col("created").alias("invoice_created"),
        col("updated").alias("invoice_updated"),
        col("reference").alias("invoice_reference"),
        col("payment_term"),
        col("incl_vat").alias("invoice_incl_vat"),
        explode(col("lines")).alias("line"),
        col("source_file")
    ).select(
        col("invoice_id"),
        col("invoice_nr"),
        col("draft_nr"),
        col("company_id"),
        col("client_id"),
        col("client_name"),
        col("invoice_status"),
        col("invoice_description"),
        col("invoice_total_excl_vat"),
        col("invoice_total_vat"),
        col("invoice_total_incl_vat"),
        col("invoice_total_discount"),
        col("invoice_created"),
        col("invoice_updated"),
        col("invoice_reference"),
        col("payment_term"),
        col("invoice_incl_vat"),
        # Line item fields
        col("line.event_id").alias("line_event_id"),
        col("line.object_type").alias("line_object_type"),
        col("line.object_id").alias("line_object_id"),
        col("line.object_code").alias("line_object_code"),
        col("line.date").alias("line_date"),
        col("line.amount").alias("line_amount"),
        col("line.description").alias("line_description"),
        col("line.vat_rate").alias("line_vat_rate"),
        col("line.vat_amount").alias("line_vat_amount"),
        col("line.price").alias("line_price"),
        col("line.price_excl_vat").alias("line_price_excl_vat"),
        col("line.total_price").alias("line_total_price"),
        col("line.total_price_excl_vat").alias("line_total_price_excl_vat"),
        col("line.total_vat").alias("line_total_vat"),
        col("line.invoicing_number").alias("line_invoicing_number"),
        col("line.general_ledger_number").alias("line_general_ledger_number"),
        col("line.cost_center").alias("line_cost_center"),
        col("source_file")
    )
    
    print(f"✅ Invoice line items: {invoice_lines.count():,}")
    return invoice_lines

def parse_and_extract_all(df):
    """Extract all invoice data"""
    print("🔍 Extracting invoice data...")
    
    # Extract invoice lines
    invoice_lines = extract_invoice_lines(df)
    
    return invoice_lines

print("✓ Block 4 completed: Invoice line items extraction")

# Block 5: FIXED Parquet File Writing - WITH TEMP DIRECTORY
def ensure_directory_exists(dir_path):
    """Create directory if needed"""
    try:
        if not mssparkutils.fs.exists(dir_path):
            mssparkutils.fs.mkdirs(dir_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Directory warning: {e}")

def clean_temp_directory(temp_dir_path):
    """Clean temp directory"""
    try:
        if mssparkutils.fs.exists(temp_dir_path) and TEMP_DIRECTORY in temp_dir_path:
            mssparkutils.fs.rm(temp_dir_path, True)
            print(f"   Cleaned temp: {temp_dir_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Cleanup warning: {e}")

def write_single_parquet_file(df, table_name):
    """Write single Parquet file using EXACT working pattern"""
    temp_output = f"{TEMP_DIRECTORY}/{table_name}"
    final_output = f"{OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/{table_name}.parquet"
    
    print(f"🔍 Writing {table_name} as single Parquet file...")
    print(f"   Records: {df.count()}")
    
    try:
        start_time = time.time()
        
        # Ensure directories exist
        ensure_directory_exists(TEMP_DIRECTORY)
        
        # Check if final output exists and delete
        if mssparkutils.fs.exists(final_output):
            mssparkutils.fs.rm(final_output, False)
            print(f"   Removed existing output file: {final_output}")
        
        # Clean temp directory before writing
        clean_temp_directory(temp_output)
        
        # Write to temporary location
        df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("compression", "snappy").parquet(temp_output)
        
        # Find the part file
        part_files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(temp_output)
        parquet_part_file = next((f for f in part_files if f.name.startswith("part-") and f.name.endswith(".parquet")), None)
        
        if parquet_part_file:
            # Move the file to final location
            source_path = f"{temp_output}/{parquet_part_file.name}"
            mssparkutils.fs.mv(source_path, final_output, True, True)
            print(f"✓ Moved processed file to final output: {final_output}")
            
            # Clean up temp directory
            clean_temp_directory(temp_output)
            
            # Report success
            end_time = time.time()
            print(f"✓ Successfully processed file: {table_name} in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")
            
            # Verify the file
            try:
                verify_df = spark.read.parquet(final_output)
                print(f"✅ Verified: {table_name}.parquet with {verify_df.count()} rows")
                return True
            except Exception as verify_error:
                print(f"❌ Verification failed: {verify_error}")
                return False
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ Error: No part file found in {temp_output}")
            return False
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error processing file {table_name}: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        return False
        
    finally:
        # Always clean up temp directory
        clean_temp_directory(temp_output)

def write_all_tables(df, invoice_lines_df):
    """Write all tables as single Parquet files using temp approach"""
    print("💾 Writing all tables as single Parquet files...")
    
    try:
        # Derive event_id for invoices from their line items
        invoice_event_mapping = None
        if invoice_lines_df is not None and invoice_lines_df.count() > 0:
            # Get the first event_id for each invoice (assuming all lines have same event_id)
            invoice_event_mapping = invoice_lines_df.select(
                col("invoice_id"),
                col("line_event_id").alias("derived_event_id")
            ).dropDuplicates(["invoice_id"]).select("invoice_id", "derived_event_id")
        
        # Create invoices header table - join with event_id if available
        invoices_base = df.select(
            col("id").alias("invoice_id"),
            col("type").alias("invoice_type"),
            col("draft_nr"),
            col("company_id"),
            col("identifier"),
            col("invoice_nr"),
            col("client_id"),
            col("locale"),
            col("synced"),
            col("send_count"),
            col("reminder_count"),
            col("exhortation_count"),
            col("client_reference"),
            col("client_name"),
            col("client_phone"),
            col("client_email"),

            col("client_last_name"),
            col("client_address_line_1"),
            col("client_address_line_2"),
            col("client_postalcode"),

            col("client_country"),

            col("client_coc_number"),
            col("status").alias("invoice_status"),
            col("description").alias("invoice_description"),

            col("total_discount"),
            col("total_incl_vat"),

            col("internal_note"),
            col("incl_vat"),
            col("created"),
            col("updated"),
            col("source_file")
        ).dropDuplicates(["invoice_id"])
        
        # Join with event_id if available, otherwise use null
        if invoice_event_mapping is not None:
            invoices_df = invoices_base.join(
                invoice_event_mapping, 
                on="invoice_id", 
                how="left"
            ).select(
                col("derived_event_id").alias("event_id"),  # ✅ ADDED: Derived event_id

                col("synced"),
                col("send_count"),
                col("reminder_count"),
                col("exhortation_count"),
                col("client_reference"),
                col("client_name"),
                col("client_phone"),
                col("client_email"),
                col("client_first_name"),
                col("client_last_name"),
                col("client_address_line_1"),
                col("client_address_line_2"),
                col("client_postalcode"),
                col("client_city"),
                col("client_country"),
                col("client_vat_number"),
                col("client_coc_number"),
                col("invoice_status"),
                col("invoice_description"),
                col("total_excl_vat"),
                col("total_vat"),
                col("total_discount"),
                col("total_incl_vat"),
                col("parent_invoice_id"),
                col("reference"),
                col("payment_process_paused"),
                col("payment_term"),
                col("internal_note"),
                col("incl_vat"),
                col("created"),
                col("updated"),
                col("source_file")
            )
        else:
            # No line items, add null event_id
            invoices_df = invoices_base.withColumn("event_id", lit(None).cast(LongType())).select(
                col("event_id"),
                col("invoice_id"),
                col("invoice_type"),
                col("draft_nr"),
                col("company_id"),
                col("identifier"),
                col("invoice_nr"),
                col("client_id"),
                col("locale"),
                col("synced"),
                col("send_count"),
                col("reminder_count"),
                col("exhortation_count"),
                col("client_reference"),
                col("client_name"),
                col("client_phone"),
                col("client_email"),
                col("client_first_name"),
                col("client_last_name"),
                col("client_address_line_1"),
                col("client_address_line_2"),
                col("client_postalcode"),
                col("client_city"),
                col("client_country"),
                col("client_vat_number"),
                col("client_coc_number"),
                col("invoice_status"),
                col("invoice_description"),
                col("total_excl_vat"),
                col("total_vat"),
                col("total_discount"),
                col("total_incl_vat"),
                col("parent_invoice_id"),
                col("reference"),
                col("payment_process_paused"),
                col("payment_term"),
                col("internal_note"),
                col("incl_vat"),
                col("created"),
                col("updated"),
                col("source_file")
            )
        
        # Write all tables using temp approach
        success1 = write_single_parquet_file(invoices_df, "dudok_invoices")
        
        success2 = True
        if invoice_lines_df is not None and invoice_lines_df.count() > 0:
            success2 = write_single_parquet_file(invoice_lines_df, "dudok_invoice_lines")
        else:

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in write_all_tables: {e}")

print("✓ Block 5 completed: Single Parquet file writing with temp directory")

# Block 6: Main Pipeline
def run_complete_pipeline():
    """Complete pipeline execution"""
    print("🚀 Starting complete invoice pipeline...")
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # Read all invoices
        print("📂 Step 1: Reading JSON invoices...")
        df = read_staging_data()
        
        if df is None:
            print("❌ No data to process")
            return False
        
        # Extract invoice lines
        print("🔍 Step 2: Extracting invoice line items...")
        invoice_lines_df = parse_and_extract_all(df)
        
        # Write all tables
        print("💾 Step 3: Writing all tables...")
        success = write_all_tables(df, invoice_lines_df)
        
        if success:
            invoices_count = df.count()
            lines_count = invoice_lines_df.count() if invoice_lines_df else 0
            duration = time.time() - start_time
            
            print(f"\n✅ PIPELINE COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!")
            print(f"📊 Invoices: {invoices_count:,}")
            print(f"📊 Invoice Lines: {lines_count:,}")
            print(f"⏱️ Duration: {duration:.2f} seconds")
            print(f"📁 Output directory: {OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/")
            
            return True
        else:
            print("❌ Pipeline failed")
            return False
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Pipeline error: {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        return False

# Verification function
def verify_parquet_outputs():
    """Verify all Parquet files are readable and properly formatted"""
    print("\n🔍 VERIFYING PARQUET OUTPUTS...")
    
    tables = ["dudok_invoices", "dudok_invoice_lines"]
    
    for table in tables:
        file_path = f"{OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/{table}.parquet"
        try:
            if mssparkutils.fs.exists(file_path):
                # Read as Parquet
                df = spark.read.parquet(file_path)
                print(f"✅ {table}: {df.count()} rows, {len(df.columns)} columns")
                
                # Show schema
                print(f"   Schema: {df.columns}")
                
                # Show sample data
                if df.count() > 0:
                    print(f"   Sample data:")
                    df.show(2, truncate=True)
                
            else:
                print(f"❌ {table}: File not found")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ {table}: Error reading - {e}")

print("✓ Complete pipeline ready")

print("2. Verify: verify_parquet_outputs()")

print("\n🚀 AUTO-EXECUTING PIPELINE...")
success = run_complete_pipeline()

if success:
    print("\n🔍 VERIFYING OUTPUTS...")
    verify_parquet_outputs()
